news.api_urls

URL routes for the token-authenticated REST API (mounted at /api/).

Path

Name

View

/api/token/

api_token

DRF obtain_auth_token (username/password to token)

/api/articles/

api_articles

news.api.views.ArticleListCreateAPIView

/api/articles/subscribed/

api_subscribed_articles

news.api.views.SubscribedArticleListAPIView

/api/articles/<pk>/

api_article_detail

news.api.views.ArticleDetailAPIView

/api/publishers/

api_publishers

news.api.views.PublisherListAPIView

/api/newsletters/

api_newsletters

news.api.views.NewsletterListCreateAPIView

/api/users/

api_users

news.api.views.UserListAPIView

/api/approved/

api_approved

news.api.views.ApprovedArticleAPIView
